mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0011.retrieveBandList */ a.employee_no , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_start_date , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.end_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS effective_end_date , a.grade_title_code , a.competency_grade_point_code AS band FROM tb_pay_emp_grade_point_n a WHERE a.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND a.employee_no = #{employeeNo} ORDER BY a.end_yyyymmdd DESC
